name: Personal Cable TV Jellyfin Companion
description: Unofficial Personal Cable TV companion integration for Jellyfin 10.11.10.
overview: Adds the Personal Cable TV guide experience to supported Jellyfin clients. LG/webOS channel surfing is verified; Roku Jellyfin-client support is limited.

versions.changelog: Verified LG/webOS channel-surfing release. During Personal Cable TV live playback, Up/Down changes channels while pause, rewind, fast-forward, seek/scrub, and chapter-skip remain blocked. Known limitation: the Jellyfin Roku client does not support Companion Up/Down channel surfing and may still expose Pause. Roku users should use the dedicated P.Cable TV Companion Roku app for the full live-TV experience.
